title: Airflow Executable SDK Bundle Metadata
description: Build-time manifest declaring DAG and task identifiers exposed by an Airflow native-executable SDK bundle. See the Executable Bundle Spec documentation in the Airflow Task SDK.

airflow_bundle_metadata_version.description: Bundle-spec version this manifest conforms to (currently '1.0').

sdk.description: Identifies the SDK that produced the bundle.

version.description: SDK version used at build time.

supervisor_schema_version.description: Dated supervisor wire-schema version the bundle was compiled against (e.g. '2026-06-16'). The coordinator passes this value to the supervisor so it can downgrade outbound messages / upgrade inbound messages to a shape the bundle understands.

source.description: Original filename of the primary Dag source file (e.g. 'example.go'). Bundle formats with an embedded source region use this as its display name; other formats treat it as the logical authoring name.

digests.description: Digests the packer records, so a consumer can compare a stored value instead of computing one. Each value is a lower-case hex SHA-256.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of the binary region: the same value as the trailer's binary_sha256. Task execution still recomputes the trailer's digest.

cache.description: Stays the same across packs of the same inputs and changes when any region of the bundle changes. It is read, never recomputed, so it does not prove the bundle is intact. The producer defines how it is computed; consumers only compare it for equality.

dags.description: Mapping of dag_id to DAG entry. Every dag_id the bundle exposes must appear here.

dagEntry.description: Static description of a single DAG declared in the bundle.

tasks.description: Static list of task_ids declared in the DAG.
